# Josie Pye

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye wears dresses featuring flounces, which are considered particularly stylish for the fall season.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known for being disagreeable, outspoken, and sharp-tongued, while possessing very little imagination. She has a natural gift for walking board fences and earns recognition for her skill in knitting lace. Attending college purely for education's sake, she does not need to earn her own living.

## History

Josie Pye possessed a natural, well-cultivated talent for walking board fences. At a party, she dared [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Later, while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Josie visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and Ruby, bringing news about an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and later anxiously discussing final examinations and commencement plans with them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Quotes

> "Queen’s is to get one of the Avery scholarships after all. The word came today. Frank Stockley told me—his uncle is one of the board of governors, you know. It will be announced in the Academy tomorrow."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

> "If I don’t pass this year I’m coming back next. My father can afford to send me. Anne, Frank Stockley says that Professor Tremaine said Gilbert Blythe was sure to get the medal and that Emily Clay would likely win the Avery scholarship."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)

> "I dare you to climb up there and walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry’s kitchen roof."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)

> "I don’t believe anybody could walk a ridgepole. You couldn’t, anyhow."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)

> "Are you going to be back next year, Miss Stacy?"
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030)
